name: pdk-geojson-etl
instr:
We use the geojson library in /app to convert a survey contractor's exports from US survey feet to metres with `geojson.load`, `geojson.utils.map_coords(lambda v: v * 1200 / 3937, obj)` and `geojson.dump`. Their new exports come out wrong: elevations go missing, bboxes are off, some don't load, and members move around in our line by line diff. Two of the exports are in /data/exports/.

Loading an export (`geojson.load` or `geojson.loads`) and dumping it straight back (`geojson.dump` or `geojson.dumps`) should give the file's JSON, with every member of every object in the file's order. Features and geometries should still load as the library's classes, and a geometry whose coordinates aren't numbers should still raise ValueError.

map_coords should convert every value of every position and change nothing else at any level, member order included, without modifying the object passed in. Every bbox in the result should hold the minimum and then the maximum of each axis it covers, from its own object's converted positions, with as many values as before.

For exact numbers we also load with `parse_float=decimal.Decimal` and convert with Decimal arithmetic, but then dumping fails. Decimals should come out of `dump` and `dumps` as JSON numbers with every digit, wherever they are, and options such as indent and sort_keys should still work. A Decimal NaN or infinity should raise ValueError like a float one.

The tests in /app/tests must keep passing, and flake8 (CI uses a 100 character
